title: A patent proves a filing and its contents, not performance
note: The refusal is about the assertion kind, not the source: the same patent settles a document-existence claim completely.

claim.wording: The disclosed apparatus produces net directional thrust without propellant expulsion.

assertions.quote: In operation the apparatus is said to produce a net directional thrust in the absence of propellant expulsion
assertions.scope: patent grants and their examination record
